value.rationale: Moran I and Geary C are canonical spatial-autocorrelation statistics whose different sensitivities are widely recognized. The result isolates the structural source of possible ranking disagreement: regular degree forces exact ordering equivalence, while degree heterogeneity introduces an additional weighted-variance term. The sharp five-vertex failure and complete first graph-class census provide minimal, reproducible benchmarks for interpretation and implementation testing.
